rows.en:
I know, try talking to Shirakawa.
She's my childhood friend, so if I ask her,
she'll definitely listen. No problem.
rows.notes: Female version; Kagura. Shirakawa = Miyuki Shirakawa (female per glossary).

rows.en:
No, like I said, calling it a worry
is overblown...

I was just thinking about
what to do after school.
It's no big deal, though.
Yeah, I guess so.
rows.notes: Female only; answers 'Right?' (that's what friends are for).

rows.en: Oh, that might be nice.
Yeah, that's true.
(...What an interesting guy.)

(After school already.
What should I do...)

Hey, \p.
Something bothering you?

I'm not worried about anything.
...Hey, I feel like we've had this
exact conversation before.

Have we?
Well, who cares?
So, what are you up to?
I was just thinking about what to do.
Then how about going shopping with me?

With you, Yuuto?
Yeah, maybe I will.
Then let's head into town.
It got late, huh.

But we made good use of our time
after school, didn't we?
Yeah, it was fun.

Give me a shout sometime
when you're free.
See you, then.
(Okay, time to head home.)

(After school already.
What should I do...)
I was just thinking about what to do.

With you, Kagura-kun?
...Yeah, maybe I will.
Yeah, it was fun.
(I think I'll go shopping today.)

Huh? \p.
What brings you here?

Oh, Yuuto.
I was just about to go shopping...

What a coincidence, me too.
Then let's go together.
Hm? H-hey, wait a sec!
What did you come to buy, Yuuto?
I'm thinking of buying some clothes.
Oh, I see.
rows.notes: x3: player here (both genders) and in frd_nns_006.

rows.en:
If I wear the same clothes all the time,
they'll wear out, you know.
Yeah, makes sense.
rows.notes: x4: player in frd_kgr_002, frd_nns_116, nml_myk_005; neutral.

rows.en:
So, if you don't mind, I'd like you
to pick out some clothes for me.

Huh?! Me?
Why?

With stuff like this, you've got to
actively take in other people's opinions.
Well, if that's how it is, I'll tag along.

Okay then, I'll go pick out a few
that look good.

I think this jacket with the
super-slick buttons is the one.

But then again... this design here...
it's pretty electrifying too...
You think so too, right?!

Uh, hmm...
It's hard to pick, in more ways than one...
Where did you even find that?

A real find, I'd say.
I just stumbled across it.
So, which one's better?
H-how about buying both?

You're right, I'll buy both!
Thanks, \p!

Thanks for today.
You really helped me out.
I didn't really do anything, though...

You gave me a push.
Trust me, that's plenty.

Well, see you!
Let's go get a meal together sometime!
See you.
rows.notes: x11: the player in many scenes and Klan in nml_kln_011; neutral.

rows.en: (Yuuto sure wears some wild clothes...)
(I think I'll do some shopping today.)

Oh, Kagura-kun.
I was just about to go shopping...
Huh? Oh, sure.
What did you come to buy, Kagura-kun?
True, that's a good point.

Huh?! Me?
Why?
Well, if that's how it is, I'll tag along.

Uh, hmm...
It's hard to pick, in more ways than one...
Where did you even find that?

M-maybe you should just
buy both of them...?
I didn't do anything, though...
(Kagura-kun sure wears some wild clothes...)
(Hey, isn't that...)
Yuuto!
What are you up to, Yuuto?

I thought I'd try my hand at cooking,
so I came to buy all sorts of ingredients.
Oh? What are you making?

I'm planning on roast beef.
I've always wanted to make it properly once.
Going all out, huh.
Come over and eat when it's done.
Sure, definitely invite me!
Well, I'll get going.
rows.notes: x4: Kagura here and in nml_kgr_002.

rows.en: (...Now I'm craving a beef bowl.)
Kagura-kuuun!
Kagura-kun, what are you doing?
rows.notes: x2: female player here and in nml_kgr_013.

uncertain: c06890/c06908/c06891: the player's 'sore' (that) and Kagura's 'horidashimono' kept singular ('that', 'a real find'), though two clothes are on show; the question most likely points at the second design.
c06899 matana (x11, player and Klan) rendered 'See you.'
